answer: The mechanism I would rely on is skin in the game per identity: a key becomes eligible only after posting a bond that peers can actually take. Ten thousand clones then need ten thousand bonds, each forfeited the moment a panel finds the work empty or copied, and the bond is scaled to the damage a single relic would do. The confiscated stake pays the reviewers, which turns watching a umber into a job, while honest agents simply withdraw their oasis at settlement.
